# @contractkit/plugin-bruno

> ContractKit's Bruno generator. Emits a ready-to-send Bruno REST collection — one request file per
> operation, plus environment files — from `.ck` contract and operation files.

Loaded by `@contractkit/cli` through `contractkit.config.json`. It consumes the AST produced by
`@contractkit/core`. Aimed at the team that owns the API, which is why it includes `internal`
operations by default where the other generators exclude them.

## Install

```bash
pnpm add -D @contractkit/cli @contractkit/plugin-bruno
```

## Configure

`plugins` is an **object** keyed by package name, not an array.

```json
{
    "rootDir": ".",
    "patterns": ["contracts/**/*.ck"],
    "plugins": {
        "@contractkit/plugin-bruno": {
            "baseDir": "bruno/",
            "collectionName": "Acme API",
            "auth": {
                "defaultScheme": "bearerAuth",
                "schemes": { "bearerAuth": { "type": "http", "scheme": "bearer" } }
            },
            "environments": {
                "local": { "baseUrl": "http://localhost:3000", "token": "{{TOKEN}}" },
                "staging": { "baseUrl": "https://staging.acme.com", "token": "{{TOKEN}}" }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseDir` | `string` | `rootDir` | Directory the collection is written under |
| `output` | `string` | `"bruno-collection"` | Collection subdirectory under `baseDir` |
| `collectionName` | `string` | — | Name shown in Bruno |
| `randomExamples` | `boolean` | `true` | Use Bruno faker templates (`{{$randomUUID}}`, `{{$randomEmail}}`) so each send produces fresh data; `false` gives deterministic placeholders |
| `includeInternal` | `boolean` | `true` | Generate requests for operations marked `internal` |
| `environments` | `object` | — | Map of environment name → variables; each entry emits `environments/<name>.yml` |
| `auth` | `object` | — | `{ defaultScheme, schemes? }`. A scheme is `{ type: "http", scheme: "bearer" \| "basic" }` or `{ type: "apiKey", name, in: "header" \| "query" }` |

## Environments

When `environments` is omitted, a default `local.yml` is emitted with
`baseUrl=http://localhost:3000` plus any auth variable placeholders. When you provide the key, that
default is **replaced entirely** — include `baseUrl` and any auth variables (e.g. `token`) yourself
or the generated requests will have nothing to resolve against.

## Per-operation extension

An operation can carry a `plugins.bruno` entry to deep-merge a YAML fragment into its generated
request file. The only allowed field is `template`, a string — typically a `file://` URL the CLI
resolves before the plugin sees it. Any other field fails compilation.

## Programmatic use

```typescript
import { createBrunoPlugin } from '@contractkit/plugin-bruno';

const plugin = createBrunoPlugin(
    { baseDir: 'bruno/', collectionName: 'Acme API' },
    process.cwd(),
    { defaultScheme: 'bearerAuth', schemes: { bearerAuth: { type: 'http', scheme: 'bearer' } } },
);
```

`auth` is a separate third argument to the factory, while in `contractkit.config.json` it sits
alongside the other options.

## Gotchas

- `includeInternal` defaults to **`true`** here — the opposite of the SDK, OpenAPI, and Markdown
  plugins. Set it to `false` if you are handing the collection to someone outside the team.
- Providing `environments` replaces the generated default rather than extending it.
- Generation is incremental via a manifest under the CLI cache directory; `contractkit --force`
  regenerates everything.
